description: Main source code for a Zephyr-based USB HID and CDC device handling multiple buttons, mouse movements, and keyboard input with event-driven architecture.

methods.name: app_evt_free
methods.description: Frees an event object back to the heap.

methods.name: app_evt_put
methods.description: Adds an event object to the FIFO.

methods.name: app_evt_get
methods.description: Retrieves an event object from the FIFO.

methods.name: app_evt_flush
methods.description: Clears all events from the FIFO.

methods.name: app_evt_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new event object from the heap.

methods.name: clear_mouse_report
methods.description: Creates and enqueues a mouse clear event.

methods.name: clear_kbd_report
methods.description: Creates and enqueues a keyboard clear event.

methods.name: ascii_to_hid
methods.description: Converts ASCII character to HID key code.

methods.name: needs_shift
methods.description: Determines if a character requires shift modifier.

methods.name: cdc_mouse_int_handler
methods.description: UART interrupt handler for mouse input.

methods.name: cdc_kbd_int_handler
methods.description: UART interrupt handler for keyboard input.

methods.name: callbacks_configure
methods.description: Configures GPIO callback for a button.
